rules.name: Evidence colors
rules.body: Pair color with symbols and labels; never equate history with current acceptance.

dos: Preserve real dates and per-host cohorts.
Use teal Windows, blue Linux, orange macOS consistently.
donts: Do not copy older reference counts.
Do not manufacture fixed-cohort progress from a growing corpus.
